subject: Vessel Movement Plan for the next 48 Hrs. 14-May-2026
narrative:
All,

Please see the below Vessel Movement plan for next 48hrs.:


Allianz Juno...



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Shuaiba Port, Vessel will remain STBY at Shuaiba Port.

  *   Tomorrow 15th May, Vessel will sail to Rig Oriental Phoenix via NSBP with Crew Change Pax & Cargo, ETD at 08.00hrs. Vessel will return to Shuaiba Port Via Oriental Dragon-1 & North Port.



  Crest Argus 1...



  *   Vessel currently STBY at Shuaiba Port, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Dragon-1.
  *   Tomorrow 15th May, Vessel will be ready to sail after completion of discharging OBM slops to Oriental Dragon-1, ETD TBC.


Crest Argus 3...



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Rig Oriental Phoenix, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Phoenix.
  *   Tomorrow 15th May, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Phoenix.



Crest Argus 5....



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Oriental Dragon-1, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Dragon-1.
  *   Tomorrow 15th May, Vessel will sail to Shuaiba Port once Crest Argus-1 arrives at OD-1 ETD TBC.



Crew change details will be sent by Rig Logistics/ Aisha/ Ahmed Modather.



Gary,

Kindly approve the above Vessel Movement Plan.

Regards,
